blocks.caption: A copper vat full of gears

blocks.text: Three skies go in, one golden essence comes out. The first time I heard its gears turn, I knew the Furies were within reach.

It hums in the Cloud Refinery, an island that appears in the End when the dragon dies for the fourth time. Follow the Refinery Compass. Mine it with a pickaxe to take it home; the next dragon death grows a new one in the refinery.

The compressor is one block that grows into a machine three blocks wide, three deep and five high. Place it on the ground: it fills the 3 by 3 square around the block you place and rises five blocks. All that space must be free, and it must fit under the build limit, or it will not go down.
Three input slots take a flask or tank of Cloud, Steam and Ethereal Essence. The output slot takes an empty container, or one already holding Intensified Cloud Essence.

Each cycle takes one unit from each input and adds five units of Intensified Cloud Essence to the output, a cycle every tenth of a second. The gears turn and the vat bubbles while it works. It stops when an input runs dry, or when the output is full or holds another essence.

blocks.caption: Intensified Essence serves the mythics, tanks and absorbers
